ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_UMBRALSHOT_SPECIAL_UNL.Name: Void Blast
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_UMBRALSHOT_SPECIAL_UNL.Description: When a short distance from a Behemoth, occasionally spawn a ball of unstable Umbral energy that can be launched in a cone of projectiles that do 300 damage each.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SPHERE.Description: When a short distance from a Behemoth, occasionally spawn a ball of shield energy that grants all nearby players {Magnitude} shields when destroyed.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SPHERE_FROST_ME.Name: Shield Sphere{Quality}

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_EARTHSHAKER.Name: Lady Luck's Barrage

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_EARTHSHAKER_SPECIAL_UN.Name: Lady Luck's Barrage
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_EARTHSHAKER_SPECIAL_UN.Description: Dealing stagger damage builds up a reserve of cannon balls, which are fired from above every minute.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_FLAMEBANE.Name: Flamebane
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_FLAMEBANE.Description: Adds 20% Blaze Resistance, Lantern Hold grants +{Magnitude} damage as Frost on next hit.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_LANTERN_TAP_WOUNDING.Name: Exposed Weakness{Quality}

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_LANTERN_TAP_WOUNDING_S.Description: Add {Magnitude} wound damage to each weapon attack.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_DODGE_DAMAGE_BUFF.Name: Shadow Dodge
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_DODGE_DAMAGE_BUFF.Description: Dealing damage accumulates charges of Shadow Dodge.  Dodging through an attack expends a charge, causing an umbral explosion that can interrupt behemoths.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_DODGE_DAMAGE_BUFF_SPEC.Name: Shadow Dodge

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_SHIELD_SUMMON_BUFF.Name: Shield Elemental Summoner
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_SHIELD_SUMMON_BUFF.Description: Gaining 1500 total shield from any source summons a random stationary elemental to assist you for thirty seconds.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WOUNDING_SUMMON_BUFF_SP.Name: Elemental Summoner

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SHRAPNEL_BUFF.Name: Shrapnel{Quality}
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SHRAPNEL_BUFF.Description: When any shield expires or is refreshed, it explodes, dealing damage in an AoE equal to {Magnitude} times the remaining shield value.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SHRAPNEL_BUFF_S.Name: Shrapnel
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_SHIELD_SHRAPNEL_BUFF_S.Description: When any shield expires or is refreshed, it explodes, dealing damage in an AoE equal to {Magnitude} times the remaining shield value.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_TOXICITY_BUFF.Name: ~DNT~ Toxicity
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_TOXICITY_BUFF.Description: ~DNT~ Take 25% less poison damage. While taking poison damage, gain {Magnitude Percent}% bonus damage.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_IH_TERRA.Name: Explosive Force
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_IH_TERRA.Description: Hammer Only - Gain an additional 100% stagger per hit, and cause a 1000 damage Terra explosion every 5000 stagger dealt.

ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_EASTER_EGG_NO.Name: ~DNT~ YOU SHOULDN'T SEE THIS
ESC_BUFF_STANDARD_EASTER_EGG_NO.Description: ~DNT~ IF YOU SEE THIS AMP, TELL KRISTEN

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_DEFENDER.Name: Avatar of Control
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_DEFENDER.Description: Deal 50% increased Stagger Damage per hit. Reduce Frostbite for all Slayers when a Behemoth is Staggered or Interrupted.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_DEFENDER_SCOUT_U.Name: Controlled Subtlety
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_DEFENDER_SCOUT_U.Description: Your Avatar of Control slows the actions of Behemoths for a short time when staggering them.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_WARRIOR_MEND_UPG.Name: Destructive Unity
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_WARRIOR_MEND_UPG.Description: Your Avatar of Destruction also heals all Slayers for a small percentage of any of your crit damage dealt.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER.Name: Avatar of Unity
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER.Description: Gain a chance to grant +7 shields to all Slayers when dealing damage. Slightly reduce frostbite on all Slayers who gain these shields. Frostbite is not reduced by other shield sources.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER_DEF_UPGRA.Name: Unifying Control
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER_DEF_UPGRA.Description: Your Avatar of Unity now grants 14 shielding to Slayers on each activation.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER_SCOUT_UPG.Name: Unifying Subtlety
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_MENDER_SCOUT_UPG.Description: Your Avatar of Unity now causes a 40 damage detonation of Frost Damage around you every time it activates.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_SCOUT.Name: Avatar of Subtlety
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_SCOUT.Description: Deal 50% increased Wound Damage per hit. Reduce Frostbite for all Slayers when a Behemoth part becomes Wounded or Broken.

ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_SCOUT_DEF_UPGRAD.Name: Subtle Control
ESC_BUFF_SPECIAL_WARDEN_SCOUT_DEF_UPGRAD.Description: Your Avatar of Subtlety now also slows Behemoths who have been wounded for a short time. Cannot apply again until the slow has ended.
